label: Solar Skunk #22

Aroma is very clear citrus and sharp fuel, but little secondary complexity is recorded.

Golden-green presentation is bright and consistent.
The grower kept a complete photo sequence but recorded almost no written observations.

notes.terps: The profile is clear but comparatively simple.

label: Frost Compass #08
evidence: Compact sample has good symmetry but fewer strong lateral branches than the top structure entries.
The sample card shows the most extensive visible gland coverage in the deck.
Aroma is clean lemon and mineral with moderate complexity and strong consistency.
Recorded output is near the lower third of the fictional deck.
Silver-green contrast is striking and consistent from top to lower sample.
Documentation includes dates, labels, photos, comparisons, and a concise selection summary.
A weak early trend was investigated with one variable at a time and the final notes identify which observation changed after each test.

notes.structure: Symmetry is good, but lateral development is only moderate.
notes.resin: This packet defines the top visible-coverage benchmark.
notes.terps: Clean and consistent, with moderate rather than exceptional complexity.
notes.yield: The fictional record places output in the lower third.

label: Ruby Engine #31
evidence: Strong upright branches carry a dense top, though the left side is visibly less balanced.
Visible gland coverage is heavy and consistent on most of the card.
Aroma notes identify fruit, fuel, and pepper, but the description changes noticeably between observers.
Recorded output is the second-highest entry in the fictional deck.
Red-purple accents are vivid but unevenly distributed.
The record contains excellent final measurements but only a few progress photos.
A support issue was recognized early, compared against prior notes, corrected once, and confirmed with later photos.

notes.structure: Strong support is offset by visible side-to-side imbalance.
notes.resin: Coverage is heavy and consistent enough for a high score.
notes.terps: Complex notes are present, but observer consistency is weaker.
notes.yield: The record places this second in the game deck for output.
notes.color: Vivid accents score well, but distribution is uneven.
notes.documentation: Final measurements are strong; progress documentation is thinner.
notes.problem-solving: The issue was identified, compared, corrected, and confirmed.
